# FMC Media PC 0.3.25 — Cartoons

- **Cartoons** appears right below Anime, with Cartoony's two public catalogues, Arabic title search, collection and movie/series filters, and title/year sorting. The whole filtered catalogue shows at once, with artwork loading as you scroll.
- Title pages keep the provider's own seasons and episode order; unclassified episodes stay separate, and stable episode keys keep your progress right when the catalogue changes. Films with several language versions keep every version selectable.
- Explicit seasons and reviewed franchise parts are grouped into one title page (for example My Hero Academia's five seasons plus its ONA entries, Inazuma Eleven's four entries); duplicate pages become one card with selectable editions. Every source entry and episode identity is kept, and existing progress carries over to the grouped page.
- Cartoons is in global search and in All: Arabic diacritics, hamza and taa marbuta variants and small spelling mistakes are understood, as are reviewed Arabic/English names such as Dragon Ball, Avatar, Inazuma Eleven and My Hero Academia. Results are labelled Anime or Cartoon with their source.
- Episodes open in the player with resume, seeking and Up Next. Media links are renewed at playback, and everything goes through the app's own secure DNS connection like the other sources.
- Posters that were missing (such as Miss Elif and Anpanman) now load; a removed cover falls back to the work's banner or episode artwork, and a missing image shows the title's name instead of a broken icon.

Also includes everything in 0.3.24: instant player exit, grouped settings with one Connected accounts page, and full mouse control in the player.

Cartoons was built and validated by Codex (frontend, source and native tests; live catalogue, search, artwork and playback checks recorded in `evidence/cartoons-validation-0.3.23.json`). For this release the work was combined with 0.3.24 and all test suites were run again.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
